contentBlocks.text: This week you built a real news-writing toolkit — a definition, a structure, a question checklist — then used all of it to write your own report. Let's review the whole set.

Quick review: ਖ਼ਬਰ must be ਸੱਚ, ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ, and current (Day 1). The inverted pyramid puts the most important ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ first (Day 2). A strong opening answers the five ਸਵਾਲ — ਕੌਣ, ਕੀ, ਕਦੋਂ, ਕਿੱਥੇ, ਕਿਉਂ (Day 3). You combined all of this into one complete report with a ਸੁਰਖੀ (Day 4). Look back at your Day 4 report: identify which of the five ਸਵਾਲ it answers, and explain in one sentence why its structure follows the inverted pyramid.

Excellent work this week — you now have real analytical and compositional tools for Punjabi-language news writing. These same tools will apply throughout this course as we study more of Punjabi-language media and journalism.

objectives: Review and correctly define ਖ਼ਬਰ's three qualities, the inverted pyramid, and the five ਸਵਾਲ
Identify these elements within the student's own Day 4 news report
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child re-read their own Day 4 report and label which questions it answers.
3. Complete the cumulative review worksheet.
4. Discuss any uncertain answers together before finishing.
5. Celebrate finishing the first full week of this unit — these tools will be used throughout the rest of the course.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to point to and read aloud (rather than write out) where each element appears in their report
Ready for more: ask them to suggest one small revision to their Day 4 report that would answer one more of the five ਸਵਾਲ
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the four elements (news definition, inverted pyramid, five questions, or headline-writing) needs the most re-teaching
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਖ਼ਬਰ must be ਸੱਚ (true), ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ (important), and current. 2. The inverted pyramid puts the most important information first. 3. The five ਸਵਾਲ are ਕੌਣ, ਕੀ, ਕਦੋਂ, ਕਿੱਥੇ, ਕਿਉਂ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's news-writing foundation before the unit continues further into Punjabi-language media and journalism, matching the 'consolidate before adding more' pacing established across this session.
